narrative.intro: Ram System Gmbh recorded total obligations of $487M in FY2026 to date. Ram System Gmbh received 8 awards in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $60.9M and obligations up 10.5% year over year. Obligations in FY2026 to date match the Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing NAICS entry at $487M. Historical fiscal-year obligations show FY21 at $136M, FY22 at $6M, FY23 at $680M, FY24 at $11.9M, and FY25 at $441M. Current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date. The figures presented are contract obligations except where tables list total contract values. This summary emphasizes the scale and concentration of Ram System Gmbh’s FY2026 to date obligations and places the current-year numbers in the context of five prior fiscal years.
